nom: Veriphy Skincare Hit or Mist Facial Toner

avis.titre: A toner that sprays on....YES!!!A toner that sprays on....YES!!!
avis.texte: I've never understood why toners are sold in bottles requiring pouring in one's hand to apply on the face. They are runny and liquid as water and it always ends up running down my arms in the process. It's wasteful, messy and inconvenient. Thankfully, Veriphy has bottled their toner in a spray bottle! Hallelujah!! Praise be to the facial toner gods! Verify is an amazing brand that utilizes the latest and greatest ingredients. This is my 3rd product from them and my skin is absolutely glowing! Simply spray this on after cleansing your face and then apply your serum, cream, etc. I also spray a light mist on later in the day when I'm tired and want to feel a bit of refreshing mist. One of the game changing ingredients is sea silt extract. Benefits include improving skin elasticity, helps skin retain moisture and activates the skin's own protective functions. I personally have not always used toners because I hate how they drip down my arms while applying. I've tried using cotton balls but it was wasteful because they retain some of the product. I've also always been an exceptionally busy person and would apply a moisturizer with spf and call it a day. However, this spray toner by Veriphy is so easy to apply - spray and I gently pat it in my skin - that I've come to love it. My favorite time to use it is when I want an afternoon pick-me-up. I love being able to lightly mist this on my face, giving it all the benefits of the wonderful ingredients plus the simply refreshing feeling

avis.titre: This has a light sent that dissipates quicklyThis has a light sent that dissipates quickly
avis.texte: If you’re looking for a more natural version of a skin toner, I think this is a great option. Your main ingredient is aloe and water with ginger and flower extracts to complement the mix for a nice natural option in a facial toner. I noticed a light fragrance when I first sprayed this on my skin. The scent quickly dissipated which I prefer. I do not like to continually smell the fragrance of a toner after I’ve used it. This left my skin feeling fresh and lightly moisturized for hours after using. This bottle is tall and thin, which Will make it an easy size to carry with you. You can spritz it on your face throughout the day to refresh your skin. I would say you would not even have to always use it just on your face. I enjoyed the fresh feeling that I got just from spraying it on my arms as well. I would highly recommend this product. If you are looking for something that is more natural and something that is completely vegan. I felt this was a great value for the high-quality product I received.

This face mist comes in a beautiful green frosted glass bottle. It sprays in a very nice mist... the absolute perfect type of mist for a facial spray. I use this after cleansing and before using my other skincare (oils, serums, or moisturizer) and I feel like it really helps to amplify the results of my other skincare. I do think it's a tad pricy for what it is and the amount you get. I've used many face mists with a variety of pricing and have had some that were more reasonably priced with similar results. If you're willing to spend it, I do think it's a good product. The only negative I have about the product itself is I don't LOVE the scent. It's not strong, thankfully, but it's got an odd scent to me... I can't really place it... somewhat like cotton, vanilla, and rubber or something else that I would not really associate with skincare. My husband did tell me I smelled nice after using this, so I guess it can't be all that bad, just not a big fan myself. 😆

avis.titre: Lightweight mist, hydrating and nourishing!Lightweight mist, hydrating and nourishing!
avis.texte: This Hit of mist Facial toner sprays out a light mist and it absorbs quickly. It has a light and sweet fragrance as well. Some of the key ingredients in this formula are: -Phytoglycogene -Glacial Mineral Water -White Tea -Blue lotus extract Together these ingredients should even your skin tone, hydrate your skin, minimize pore size and nourish your skin. I personally found this facial spray very hydrating. It also brightened my skin a little and made it look more plump. I like it so far.

avis.titre: I just don't like the smellI just don't like the smell
avis.texte: I wish I could get past the scent, because I think that it's actually a nice product. I tested it on the inside of my forearm, and it felt nice and soothing and didn't leave any kind of residue. But the smell is strange; it's like a very sweet vanilla with a note that smells very chemical to me. I will say that the smell dissipates quickly, but it's a no for me.

avis.titre: Made my skin feel calmed and soothed
avis.texte: This toner is quite gentle and non-irritating. I like that it has a spray nozzle on it (all the other toners I've tried don't have this). It's soothing and calming to my skin. It absorbs well and isn't sticky. It also doesn't smell bad. I like how it makes my skin feel. I've tried some other toners and I've noticed that some toners can feel harsh to the skin. I'm happy that this one doesn't. It comes in a beautiful bottle too.

This is a nice toner. The bottle is nice and I like the actual spray. Enough product comes out and it sprays a good amount across lol of my face, not just one spot. I like the soothing properties that it has. I have inflammation and redness around my check bones and I notice it helps reduces it. It also feel very nice and refreshing on my skin. It’s great for days that I’m not wearing makeup and need to wake my skin up.

This toner has a fine light mist that I can use with a few spritzes without patting in or sometimes if I want a little more, I can spritz a few more times and pat in without having anything drip. The scent is very light, barely discernible. Very hydrating. My skin has been very dry this winter and this mist seems to be helping with that.

I have ordered a few products from the Veriphy skin line and have yet to be disappointed. This facial mist toner is meant to be used on a cleansed face, and it really hydrates your skin. You simply put this on before your other serums and moisturizers, both morning and night after cleansing your face. Not only does this product really hydrate your skin, but it is also vegan and made with quality ingredients.

avis.titre: Gentle On My Sensitive Rosacea Skin, Smells Really Good
avis.texte: I have mild rosacea and I was worried about trying this but I like that it's natural and it doesn't contain harmful ingredients. It's refreshing and proven to be gentle enough for me to use, it doesn't sting or cause irritation and it provides moisture. I also love the scent, it smells so good! The spray nozzle mists well and I love the look of the bottle and the packaging it comes in. This is a great facial toner mist, I'm glad I decided to try it!

The product comes in a very nice green bottle. The design of the nozzle is very convenient to use. You simply apply it morning and night after cleansing and before other serums and moisturizers. It absorbs quickly. It has a light fragrance. I feel my skin is hydrated and fresh. It really helps amplify the effects of my other skincare products. It's vegan and made with high-quality ingredients. I would recommend it.

I use a few products by Veriphy and I've never been disappointed. This Hit or Mist toner spray has a ginger scent but it's like a candied ginger scent but it dissipates very quickly once sprayed. It's a very nice scent that doesn't bother my nose. It leaves my face feeling better or fresher when spraying some on as a pick me up in the afternoon.
Great product!! Very easy to use!! Very hydrating on the skin!! A great morning routine to add!! Mist great!! Leaving my skin feeling soft and refreshing!! Love it
The spray is nice, it is a mist. I don’t smell a fragrance. This feels cool and refreshing. I like to use it during the day just to refresh my makeup. Gives a little glow/moisturized look.
The facial toner is easy to use and absorbs fast. It doesn’t leave sticky residue.
